hebrewText: נָשִׁים֙ בְּ/צִיּ֣וֹן עִנּ֔וּ בְּתֻלֹ֖ת בְּ/עָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה

tokens.kjv: (adulter) ess, each, every, female, [idiom] many, [phrase] none, one, [phrase] together, wife, woman. Often unexpressed in English.

tokens.bdb: Tsijon (as a permanent capital), a mountain of Jerusalem
to depress literally or figuratively, transitive or intransitive (in various applications, as follows)
tokens.kjv: abase self, afflict(-ion, self), answer (by mistake for H6030 (עָנָה)), chasten self, deal hardly with, defile, exercise, force, gentleness, humble (self), hurt, ravish, sing (by mistake for H6030 (עָנָה)), speak (by mistake for H6030 (עָנָה)), submit self, weaken, [idiom] in any wise.

tokens.bdb: a virgin (from her privacy); sometimes (by continuation) a bride; also (figuratively) a city or state
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a virgin ; sometimes  a bride; also  a city or state
tokens.enLiteralWord: a virgin ; sometimes  a bride; also  a city or state
tokens.explanation: a virgin ; sometimes  a bride; also  a city or state
tokens.explanationEn: a virgin ; sometimes  a bride; also  a city or state

tokens.bdb: a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post)
tokens.kjv: Ai (from margin), city, court (from margin), town.
tokens.enLiteralWord: a city  in the widest sense
tokens.explanationEn: a city  in the widest sense

tokens.bdb: Jehudah (or Judah), the name of five Israelites; also of the tribe descended from the first, and of its territory
tokens.explanation: Yehudah — Judá, quarto filho de Jacó, tribo e reino
